역대상-6-11.title: 역대상 6장 11절 역사문법적 주해
역대상-6-11.exegesis: 10. he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem-- It is doubtful whether the person in favor of whom this testimony is borne be Johanan or Azariah. If the former, he is the same as Jehoiada, who rendered important public services ( 2Ki 11:1-20 ); if the latter, it refers to the worthy and independent part he acted in resisting the unwarrantable encroachments of Uzziah ( 2Ch 26:17 ). in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem-- described in this particular manner to distinguish it from the second temple, which was in existence at the time when this history was written.

역대상-6-68.title: 역대상 6장 68절 역사문법적 주해
역대상-6-68.exegesis: 67-81. they gave unto them of the cities of refuge-- The names of the cities given here are considerably different from those applied to them ( Jos 21:13-19 ). In the lapse of centuries, and from the revolutions of society, changes might have been expected to take place in the form or dialectic pronunciation of the names of those cities; and this will sufficiently account for the variations that are found in the lists as enumerated here and in an earlier book. As to these cities themselves that were assigned to the Levites, they were widely remote and separated--partly in fulfilment of Jacob's prophecy ( Ge 49:7 ), and partly that the various districts of the country might obtain a competent supply of teachers who might instruct the people in the knowledge, and animate them to the observance, of a law which had so important a bearing on the promotion both of their private happiness and their national prosperity.
